Training set: Six monthly fields: February, March, May, June, August, and September 2022.
Held-out validation: Two monthly fields: November and December 2022. These months were used for early stopping and checkpoint selection and are therefore held-out model-selection validation.
External evaluation: Twelve monthly fields covering January–December 2023. Inventory-input models used the fixed mean of the six 2022 training-month fields and are fixed-proxy lagged-inventory evaluations; meteorology-only is a direct temporal-holdout evaluation.

Training set: The same six 2022 training months were used, but the predefined East Asia core plus a 32-cell guard was excluded from meteorological-normalization fitting and from all training patches.
Held-out validation: November–December 2022 checkpoint selection used only valid pixels outside the East Asia core plus a larger 64-cell exclusion.
External evaluation: The East Asia core was evaluated once after all 3 models × 3 seeds had been trained and audited, with their checkpoints frozen. The pooled evaluation contained 3497 valid cells in November and 3488 in December (6985 month–cell pairs). This is a geographic-transfer evaluation, not a fully independent spatiotemporal test.

Training set: 178 daily samples from February (27), March (31), May (30), June (29), August (31), and September (30) 2022, as recorded in the finalized run manifests.
Held-out validation: 61 daily samples: 30 from November and 31 from December 2022. These samples were used for full-field validation, early stopping, and checkpoint selection.
External evaluation: 361 available daily samples from 2023. These are direct external anomaly evaluations because the anomaly models do not use inventory inputs.

Training set: No independent inverse training set. The experiment used the trained and frozen joint mean-state forward model and the train-mean processed inventory reference derived from the six 2022 mean-state training months.
Held-out validation: Target-conditioned bounded offsets were optimized separately for the November and December 2022 monthly targets. Reported primary values are arithmetic means over the two months; the same target was used for optimization and reconstruction evaluation.
